_comment: Hand-kept registry for /docs/specifications.html, the home-page Specifications section and the footer draft list. It holds draft NAMES, vectors and implementations only. Revisions, titles and status are NEVER typed here: tools/build_docs.py fetches them from the IETF Datatracker API at build time into data/datatracker.json. A draft the Datatracker does not return is shown as 'not yet posted' with no link and no revision. An implementation marked "independent": true is other people's code and is listed in the second table, Independent implementations and interop; its 'what' states only what the linked files show.

implementations.what: Reference library: build, seal and verify capsules; the Python, Go and TypeScript code all run the same vectors in CI.
Producer: one seal() call plus thin framework adapters; a Go module (go/) and a TypeScript package (ts/); Rust crates for the producer and an artifact store.
Archived (9 Oct 2026, read-only). Development continues in capsule-emit under go/. Producer: builds and signs capsules from transport-neutral observed action facts.
Archived (9 Oct 2026, read-only). Development continues in capsule-emit under ts/. Producer and verifier for the capsule format, TypeScript-native.

capsulectl: a standalone executable that seals, builds bundles and verifies. Only pre-releases so far: the latest pre-release has binaries for Linux (amd64, arm64) and macOS (arm64), with a SHA256SUMS file and a Sigstore bundle; building from source needs Go 1.27 or later.

implementations.language: Python, Rust (receipt verifier crate), Go (verifier tool)
implementations.what: Verifier: COSE_Sign1 Signed Statements, COSE Receipts (RFC9162_SHA256 and CCF), inclusion and consistency proofs. Carries no capsule semantics.
Canonical Payload Binding library and its conformance vector suite.
CLL library: append-only store, Merkle Mountain Range, signed COSE checkpoints, disclosure bundles; the draft source and its vectors.
Archived (read-only). Development continues in checkpointed-local-log under go/. Ledger with CLL checkpoints, storage interfaces and witness integration.
Archived (read-only). Development continues in checkpointed-local-log under ts/. Ledger with CLL checkpoints and durable stores, TypeScript-native.

Implementation: the TRACE Registry, a public append-only log of TRACE record fingerprints, implements the CLL draft. Its docs/mmr-checkpoint.md states Status: implemented and conformance to the CLL draft and its companion MMR / COSE Receipts mechanism. Its checkpoint layer (the CLL log and its signed, consistency-checkable checkpoints) was contributed upstream with the CLL draft author's help in trace-registry #54 (merged 1 Sep 2026). Its witness verifier uses scitt-cose. Code Apache-2.0, data CC BY 4.0.
Witness: a SCITT Transparency Service that registers a digest or checkpoint and returns an RFC 9162 COSE Receipt; one row in the witness directory.

Mesh-LLM plugin: seals a capsule for every exchange a node serves or asks for, including both sides' payment lifecycle events and settlement legs, and adds an Evidence page to the node's console. Latest release v0.1.4 (12 Oct 2026), which shows paid exchanges on that page. It runs on an unmodified mesh-llm 0.77 or newer; on a host older than mesh-llm v0.78.0 the provider seals no settlement leg.

Evidence layer: a local evidence store that seals every record as a capsule, keeps typed links between records, answers Evidence Requests and returns Evidence Bundles that the neutral bundle verifier checks on its own. The Checkpointed Local Log is its reference substrate. Used by the Mesh-LLM capsules plugin (Rust crate). Latest tags: Go module v0.7.0 (20 Oct 2026) and Rust crate evidencebook-v0.0.7 (20 Oct 2026).

Independent demo by Ty (Patches) Smith at HOL: compiles governed context with CIGAR, then records the action as an AAC -05 capsule with a local checkpoint witness and optional Hedera testnet publication; an in-page verifier names the failures when the evidence is edited.

Interop cases between the agent-action-capsule library (0.12.0) with its CPB typed digest references and the reference checks of the Decision Provenance Standard: eight cases in interop/aac/, including an AAC -05 §3.1 Producer Envelope, a CPB -06 §9.3 Signed Statement carrying cpb-refs with its negatives, and a capsule_id registered at the library’s Transparency Service with its Receipt verified by scitt-cose. The repository is the source of draft-lemonnier-scitt-decision-provenance, by Laurent Lemonnier (iSoluce).

An independent TypeScript implementation of CPB -02 §4.1, §5 (with §5.1) and §7.1, run against the scitt-payload-binding vectors at commit e0ad1c7, with an ambiguity log and a record of every pinned input.

Worked example: a self-constructed capsule in the AAC -02 format, its capsule_id computed as §5.1 defines, anchored as a bytes32 in a public on-chain registry. The repository states that it produces no SCITT Signed Statement and is not adoption or endorsement.

Runs the constructions of draft-hillier-scitt-arp against the AAC Class-1 frozen vector suite (32 cases) and the CPB conformance vectors (21), reporting for each vector where each construction agrees or diverges and why; also five typed-reference vectors built against CPB -01. Internet-Draft sources by Certisyn, Inc.

lib/grace/mobile-grid.ts builds AAC capsules (format_version 2, spec draft-mih-scitt-agent-action-capsule-02) and their COSE_Sign1 statements. Two composition packs pin AAC -02 and Composition -00: a CAID → AEC → AEB → capsule vector of eight attempts, with an independent candidate verifier of the capsule invariants, and a cross-slot conformance pack.

Two from-scratch adapters, one TypeScript and one Python, re-ran the cross-slot composition pack pinned to Composition -00: all 27 cases reproduce their pinned expectations. A from-scratch TypeScript verifier for the scitt-cose SCITT COSE vectors (tag vectors-ietf126), whose header checks cite AAC -02 §3, reproduces the declared verdicts of all six. The repository records each as a run, not a conformance verdict.

Its own conformance cases for CLL -02: checkpoint verification (§4.3) and the Consistency Registration Policy (§4.5), built on the CLL vectors vendored at a pinned digest. A Python generator and checker, and a separate Go reader with its own CBOR decoder.

examples/capsule states each call in plimsoll’s published session bundle as an AAC -05 capsule, once plimsoll’s own verifier has accepted the record, then checks the capsules with the capsule project’s Go verifier and its Python reference verifier, including copies broken on purpose. CI runs it (make capsule-suite).

A reference Attester and Verifier for draft-yossif-psea-03, with a vector suite that runs it against the WHO negative classes of Composition -00 §5.2 and reports which classes PSEA rejects and which it does not. The repository states it is not a conformance claim.
The handoff payload class, built in the CPB idiom: typed digest references, its own declared digest context, and edges reported in CPB reference states; with pinned vectors and an offline verifier.

A dataset payload profile built on CPB -03: CPB jcs after a profile-owned NFC transformation, with parents as CPB typed digest references. The artifact implements the canonicalization pipeline with 47 pinned vectors; the repository states that signing, lineage traversal and freshness are proposed work.

Uses the witness service: its conformance tests verify offline, against a pinned service key, the Receipt that capsule-anchor at witness.agentactioncapsule.org returned for an MCP-RE Signed Statement, with negatives that mutate that Receipt; a second corpus comes from a local capsule-anchor run.
Partial: core::jcs adds capsule_digest, SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS as the AAC profile specifies, beside Treeship’s own signing encoding. It is additive; nothing is signed with it.
An experimental offline SCITT registration verifier that uses scitt-cose as its backend, pinned by commit and by per-file digest.
An experimental VSTD/SCITT example: a COSE Signed Statement and an RFC 9162 inclusion receipt in a local one-entry test log, verified offline with scitt-cose 0.2.2.

An AAC Class-1 verifier written from the -05 text before any expected value was read, standard library only, then run against the agent-action-capsule v0.6.0 vectors: capsule_id identical on 94 of 94 cases and ok on 91 of 94, with two cases reported where a vector contradicts a rule the text states.
Runs the CPB -02 conformance vectors, fetched at a pinned commit, through Cedulon’s own RFC 8785 encoder in @cedulon/core and compares the digests vector by vector.

Uses the witness service: verax anchor registers each checkpoint hash at a Transparency Service and keeps the COSE Receipt; its valid-anchored test vector holds a checkpoint registered at witness.agentactioncapsule.org and that Receipt, checked against the service key.
